links.comparator_used: GPT-4o without retrieval (training knowledge alone), with electrophysiologist responses as a further reference
links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of lifestyle guidance for AF patients (error rate, specialized content, empathy, helpfulness, accuracy)
links.effect: Against electrophysiologists, GPT-4o had a lower error rate and significantly higher specialized content, empathy and helpfulness. DB GPT and PubMed GPT (RAG) were only similar to electrophysiologists on these dimensions, with strengths in exercise-related specialized content and diet-related accuracy. No numeric values are given in the abstract, and no direct RAG vs GPT-4o test is reported.
links.quote: DB GPT and PubMed GPT showed similar error rates, proportions of specialized content, empathy, and helpfulness compared to electrophysiologists, but exhibited strengths in specialized content in exercise-related and accuracy in diet-related dimensions.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to base LLM
